diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified 'oral fidaxomicin' as the medication, even though this decision depends on PF1 (the second confirmed episode), which was not accessible to the lone decision-maker. The model appears to be pattern-matching the medication name from the shared public facts (S1-S4) or using general medical knowledge rather than requiring the hidden information in PF1.
